reviewer: Codex coordinator, ten direct source/reference/candidate image inspections
producer_review_scope: Producer reports five provisional appearance dimensions with floor4.6; these remain attributed appearance-only opinions, not coordinator ten-axis numeric scores or formal QA11.
same_scene_limit: Before/after use the same pool and broadly matching actor staging. Shop layout, header, physics and costumes also change, so no pixel-isolated or whole-scene retirement claim is made.

roles.name: Bubble Duel tethered bubble

axes.contour: The same arena and shop show clean transparent interiors and broad rim highlights replacing the jagged/mottled draft. Existing tether strokes are unchanged visible art.
axes.material: Broad painted pearl, satin, shell, kelp and fur value bands fit the pool room. The isolated item sheet shows colored edge fragments around some motifs; they are not prominent in the inspected small composites, and full alpha-edge/device review remains open.
axes.palette: Pastel aqua/lilac/cream/gold belongs to the same painted pool; warm brown and cream retain the otter family. Five bubble tints and peach opponent tint share one source design, not five new designs.
axes.light: Authored highlights and cool shadows read against the same room. Existing 1024x576 room coverage is below the native background requirement and is not accepted by these observations.
axes.perspective: The objects use the existing Canvas drawing and UI atlas regions. The new otter poses read horizontal and waterborne rather than standing on the pool. All action angles and support/contact remain unreviewed.
axes.scale: The bubble is consumed at68px; item cells are256square and used as62px shop icons and90px power icons. Static sample readability does not establish physical-phone legibility or every pose/overlap.
axes.contact: Bubbles retain visible drawn tethers; these remain a separate visible-art scope. Otter swimming keys and still contact/reward images do not prove the entire motion cycle or correct contact at every transition.
axes.occlusion: The selected scene views keep the candidate props/actor visible. The new dark flat header, card shells, meter and existing pointer remain outside art acceptance; full interaction and effect overlap are open.
axes.readability: Painted item pictures supply distinct motifs, while shop names, prices and hints still depend on typography/audio support. Full non-reader comprehension, font authority and actual device/child use are not established.
axes.action_state: The45 review PNGs use private2000-pearl fixture credit, actual purchase touch controls and manually advanced game frames. They are bounded source Mobile/Speedy review, not a natural earned journey, full-speed motion acceptance or formal QA11.
